commands:
NAMES=$(git ls-files 'docs/*' \
  | grep -vE '^docs/(external|site|superpowers|evidence)/' \
  | sed 's|^docs/||; s|[.]|[.]|g' | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//')
echo "=== scripts/ ==="; git grep -nE "docs/($NAMES)" -- scripts/ ':!lib/test' | tee .prflow/tmp/sweep-scripts.txt | wc -l
echo "=== lib/ (excl lib/test) ==="; git grep -nE "docs/($NAMES)" -- lib/ ':!lib/test' | tee .prflow/tmp/sweep-lib.txt | wc -l
echo "=== config.schema.json ==="; git grep -nE "docs/($NAMES)" -- .prflow/config.schema.json …[per-command-truncated]

git ls-files 'docs/*' | grep -vE '^docs/(external|site|superpowers|evidence)/' | sed 's|^docs/||; s|[.]|[.]|g' | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//' > .prflow/tmp/names.txt; wc -c .prflow/tmp/names.txt; cat .prflow/tmp/names.txt

NAMES=$(cat .prflow/tmp/names.txt)
echo "=== scripts/ ==="; rg -nE "docs/($NAMES)" scripts/ | tee .prflow/tmp/sweep-scripts.txt | wc -l
echo "=== lib/ (excl lib/test) ==="; rg -nE "docs/($NAMES)" lib/ -g '!lib/test/**' | tee .prflow/tmp/sweep-lib.txt | wc -l
echo "=== schema ==="; rg -nE "docs/($NAMES)" .prflow/config.schema.json | tee .prflow/tmp/sweep-schema.txt | wc -l

scripts/workpad.py update 1204 --status Setup --branch "issue-1204-vendor-shipped-scripts-and-lib-still-reference" --run-link "[View run]($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID)" --replace-acs-file .prflow/tmp/acs-1204.md --note "resume-kind: fresh" --note "classification: non-bug — vendor/docs-hygiene refactor removing internal-doc references from shipped scripts/lib; no malfunction described" --reconcile-reproduction non-bug 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for spec in \
"scripts/subagent-write-probe-verdict.py:319" \
"scripts/env-propagation-probe-verdict.py:9" \
"scripts/env-propagation-probe-verdict.py:238" \
"scripts/extract-execution-cost.py:34" \
"scripts/agents-seam-probe-verdict.py:83" \
"scripts/agents-seam-probe-verdict.py:180" \
"scripts/agents-seam-probe-verdict.py:406" \
"scripts/background-tasks-probe-verdict.py:25" \
"scripts/background-tasks-probe-verdict.py:26" \
"scripts/background-tasks-probe-ve …[per-command-truncated]

for f in "scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py:24" "scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py:291" "scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py:465"; do :; done
rg -n "docs/" scripts/resolve-review-overrides.py scripts/dedupe-review-command.sh scripts/post-ci-review-trigger.sh scripts/detect-project-tools.sh scripts/refresh-app-credentials.sh scripts/scaffold-config.sh

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for f in scripts/issue-audit-state.py scripts/verification_baseline.py scripts/create-issue-context-eval.py scripts/match-lint-adjudications.py scripts/match-deferrals.py scripts/build-experiment-records.py scripts/preflight.py scripts/workpad.py scripts/workflow-flight-recorder-registry.json; do
  echo "== $f =="; rg -n "docs/" "$f" || echo "  (clean)"
done

for f in lib/preflight.sh lib/generate-env-freeze-advisory.py lib/rename-map.json lib/efficiency-trace.sh lib/efficiency-trace.jq lib/intervention-surfaces.md; do echo "== $f"; rg -n "docs/" "$f"; done
git diff --name-only | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r python3 -m py_compile && echo "py_compile ok"; python3 -m ruff check $(git diff --name-only | grep '\.py$') 2>&1 | tail -5 || echo "ruff unavailable"

TMP=$(mktemp -d); bash scripts/scaffold-config.sh "$TMP" >/dev/null 2>&1; ls "$TMP/.prflow/prompt-extensions/" | head; echo "---count---"; ls "$TMP/.prflow/prompt-extensions/"*.example | wc -l; echo "---diff sample---"; diff "$TMP/.prflow/prompt-extensions/init.md.example" .prflow/prompt-extensions/init.md.example; echo "TMPDIR=$TMP" | tee .prflow/tmp/scaffold-tmp.txt

cp .prflow/tmp/scaffold-regen/.prflow/prompt-extensions/*.example .prflow/prompt-extensions/ && rm -rf .prflow/tmp/scaffold-regen && rg -l "docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW" .prflow/prompt-extensions/ || echo "no docs refs remain"

for f in .prflow/tmp/scaffold-regen/.prflow/prompt-extensions/*.example; do cp "$f" .prflow/prompt-extensions/; done; rm -rf .prflow/tmp/scaffold-regen; rg -l "docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW" .prflow/prompt-extensions/ || echo "no docs refs remain"
find .prflow/tmp/scaffold-regen/.prflow/prompt-extensions -name '*.example' -exec cp {} .prflow/prompt-extensions/ \;

scripts/reception-record.py 2>&1 | head -20; echo "===fingerprint==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | head; echo "===claim help==="; scripts/verification-flight.py claim --help 2>&1 | head -40
scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | tee .prflow/tmp/checkout-1204.json
scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py > .prflow/tmp/checkout-1204.json; cat .prflow/tmp/checkout-1204.json
scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py | tee .prflow/tmp/checkout-1204.json
scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1204/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true); echo "trigger=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"; scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo The01Geek/prflow --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --report-failure 2>&1 | tail -2
